description: Migaku is a language-learning product with a Chrome extension, mobile apps, and a web flashcard study app for immersive learning from videos, websites, and other native content. It helps learners study vocabulary, subtitles, OCR text, and spaced-repetition flashcards across supported languages.
summary: Migaku exposes no public developer integration surface on migaku.com: its own llms.txt explicitly says there is no public API, and the site documents only user-facing apps and web study tools.
